headline: Japan quake kills at least 23 as rescuers search Kumamoto
summary: The magnitude 7.1 quake triggered an explosion at a mall, damaged homes and left thousands without power or water in southwestern Japan.
script: A magnitude seven point one earthquake hit Japan's Kyushu island on Tuesday. At least twenty-three people were confirmed dead, while a higher police tally included cases still under investigation. Rescuers continued searching damaged buildings as shelters filled.
imageAlt: Homes lie collapsed after an earthquake in southwestern Japan.
